title: ISC — AI Plan Ready Notification
description: Triggers when ISC fires an ai_plan.generated webhook. Sends an email notifying the user their AI action plan is ready to view, with an optional SMS via Twilio. Payload fields are nested under 'data': data.userEmail, data.userName, data.userPhone, data.language.

settings.note: Copy the generated Catch Hook URL and paste it into ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'ai_plan.generated'.

settings.subject: Your AI Action Plan is ready — I Supply Chain
settings.body:
✅ Your AI Action Plan is ready

Hi {{1__data__userName}},

Your AI-generated action plan has been created and is waiting for you in the platform.

→ View My AI Plan

The plan includes prioritised actions, timelines, and resource guidance tailored to your supply-chain data.


Best regards,
The I Supply Chain Team
settings.note: Connect your Gmail account. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN. {{1__data__userEmail}} and {{1__data__userName}} map to the nested data.userEmail and data.userName fields in the webhook payload.

settings.body: ✅ Your AI action plan is ready! Log in to view it: https://YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN/
settings.note: Optional — connect your Twilio account. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN. {{1__data__userPhone}} maps to data.userPhone in the payload. Remove this step if SMS/WhatsApp is not needed.

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap. Choose 'Webhooks by Zapier' as the trigger with event 'Catch Hook'.
2. Copy the Catch Hook URL and register it in ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'ai_plan.generated'.
3. Add a Gmail action. Connect your account, set To = {{1__data__userEmail}}, and paste the HTML body from this file.
4. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN in the email body.

5. All user fields (userEmail, userName, userPhone) are in the 'data' envelope — use {{1__data__userEmail}} etc. (Zapier flattens the nested object automatically when you map with the sample payload.)
6. Optionally add a Twilio (or SMS by Zapier) step. Set To = {{1__data__userPhone}}.
7. Remove the SMS step if you do not need it.
